verdict.rationale: Homebrew's own API docs reference `brew info --json` output, so at least one core command emits machine-readable JSON an agent can parse. The rest of the evidence pack does not show JSON output for other core commands such as install, list, search, outdated or bundle. Missing for 10: documented JSON flags across other core commands (list/search/outdated/install), a JSON schema or format documentation, and hands-on or independent corroboration of agent parsing.
